run 12 — Part A1, PR #137. The pointer classifier is tightened to the
owner's two narrow mechanical escapes:

  1. the input IS ONLY a citation. "BG 18.66" is a lookup; "what does
     BG 18.66 mean about surrender" is a real question that merely
     cites one, and gets five angles — the verse still arrives, pinned.
  2. a quotation must be marked as one AND at least 8 words. "surrender
     to Krishna" appears verbatim across the corpus and is a question.

No question mark and no question word is consulted anywhere. Question is
the default; everything else falls through to five angles.

Over the gold set this now selects q001-q005 and q007-q012 — eleven, not
twelve. "What does BG 3.27 mean?" is a real question again.
